three_js_game_engine.camera_type: OrthographicCamera (Isometric) or PerspectiveCamera low-angle isometric follow (Offset: X: 18, Y: 22, Z: 18)
three_js_game_engine.controls: WASD for movement, Mouse position in 3D world plane for player rotation & aiming, Left Click to Shoot, R to Reload, Shift to Sprint

lighting.sun_light: Directional light casting real-time shadows with soft shadow maps
lighting.player_flashlight: PointLight or SpotLight attached to player mesh pointing towards crosshair for fog-of-war effect

three_js_game_engine.fog: THREE.FogExp2('#08090C', 0.025) for limited visual range & atmosphere

procedural_town_map.tile_size: Large grid scale (~300x300 units) catering to high-density exploration and up to 200 player instances
elements: Asphalt Road Network with yellow dividing lines & damaged cracks
Grass Ground Tiles with high-contrast turf texture
Abandoned Houses & Wooden Sheds (Ağaç Evler & Harabeler) with collision boxes
Pine Trees & Oak Trees (Ağaçlar) randomly scattered for cover
Wooden Fences, Barrels (Variller), Brick Walls, Sandbags
Supply Crates (Mühimmat Sandıkları) offering ammo drops and score bonuses
Blood Decals on ground upon zombie/player kills

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build the frontend in React + Three.js + Tailwind CSS with dark tactical survival aesthetic.
2. Ensure all UI labels are in TURKISH as requested by the user.

3. Provide realistic low-poly 3D models or procedural Three.js meshes for the player character (with weapon model in hands), zombies (green/decaying texture, glowing eyes), pine trees, wooden houses, roads, fences, and crates.

4. Implement smooth WASD movement, mouse aiming with 3D raycasting onto ground plane, left-click shooting with muzzle flash particles, projectile/hitscan tracer rays, impact hit effects, and zombie AI chasing nearest player.
5. Implement real WebSocket or simulated high-density multiplayer sync (displaying up to 200 dynamic player dots/entities, friendly fire combat, dynamic killfeed, and real-time score updates).

6. Weapons MUST include all 4 distinct firearms specified: AK47, AK117, AK107, and Otomatik Fişek Atan Tüfek (Auto Shotgun) with distinct stats, sound effects (web audio API synth or ambient audio), recoil, and bullet spread.
7. Include comprehensive sound settings (Ses Efektleri, Müzik, Nişan Hassasiyeti).
8. Maintain data-testid attributes on all interactive UI controls, weapon cards, lobby inputs, HUD panels, leaderboard buttons, and audio toggles for robust automated testing.
